assumptions.statement: Official overall and key-area polygons are unavailable; the repository provisional boundaries are used only to organize and test the proposal.
assumptions.impact: All areas, clipping and placement must be recalculated after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership and development rights are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setbacks, demolition and statutory land-use conclusions remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Road elevations, station interfaces, curb geometry, crossings and parking inventories are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Every last-metre link requires field accessibility and traffic safety audit before design.

assumptions.statement: Existing building survey, structure, tenancy, heritage status and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Prototype footprints do not classify any existing building as retain, renovate or demolish.

assumptions.statement: Certified heritage inventories and protection zones are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Railway narratives and landmarks remain interpretive proposals; no protection line is asserted.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, fire access, energy capacity and underground conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Service nodes require professional engineering coordination before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Agency workflows, staffing, procurement, budgets and service-level agreements are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Operating models are governance prototypes, not commitments by government or operators.

assumptions.statement: Robot dimensions, speeds, sensing, insurance and operating-design domains are not fixed.
assumptions.impact: Physical-AI tests must begin in geofenced, supervised sites with human takeover and incident stop rules.
